items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Outside the recall, ask the shop for a written quote.

items.t: Mazda Connect screen freezes, reboots or ghost touches
items.job: Update Mazda Connect software or replace touchscreen
items.note: A software update alone is inexpensive. Ask the dealer about extended coverage before paying for a screen.

items.t: Backup camera picture flickers or distorts (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace rear camera and add harness seal
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Front strut bolts can loosen and affect steering (recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque front strut-to-knuckle bolts
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Liftgate struts can corrode and let the hatch fall (recall)
items.job: Replace both liftgate support struts
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Steering feels light or makes noise when turning
items.job: Repair or replace steering column assist unit
items.note: Often covered under warranty on newer cars.

items.t: Oil leak and rattle from the drive belt tensioner
items.job: Replace drive belt tensioner and belt

items.t: Broken front coil spring causes creaking over bumps
items.job: Replace front coil spring (pair)

items.t: Whining noise from the automatic transmission
items.job: Repair or replace automatic transmission
items.note: Check powertrain warranty coverage first. Rule out a cheaper wheel bearing.

items.t: Rough idle and check engine light after a freezing night
items.job: Diagnose misfire; no repair usually needed

items.t: No-start, battery drain or odd electrical faults linked to accessories
items.job: Parasitic drain test and remove accessory
items.note: Add a battery if the old one was drained too many times.

items.t: Rising oil level from fuel in the oil on short trips
items.job: Oil change and check engine diagnosis

items.t: Forward camera fault turns off safety systems
items.job: Diagnose and replace forward sensing camera
items.note: Camera needs calibration after replacement. Often covered on newer cars.

items.t: Weak heat from a clogged heater core
items.job: Flush or replace heater core
items.note: A flush is the low end; replacing the core means removing the dashboard.

items.t: Rotten egg smell from the exhaust
items.job: No repair needed; try different fuel

items.t: A/C blows warm from a leaking evaporator
items.job: Replace A/C evaporator and recharge

items.t: Slow warm-up and check engine light from thermostat stuck open
items.job: Replace coolant control valve

items.t: Windshield cracks low in the center
items.job: Replace windshield and updated cowl
items.note: Cars with a windshield camera need it recalibrated.

items.t: Wheel bearing growl or hum
items.job: Replace wheel bearing/hub

items.t: Front shock knocks or squeaks on rough roads
items.job: Replace front shock absorbers (pair)

items.t: Front brakes squeal
items.job: Replace front brake pads and resurface or replace rotors

items.t: Leather steering wheel wears or peels
items.job: Replace steering wheel
